The [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] '''DL-44 heavy blaster pistol''' was a powerful sidearm from the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] through the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
[[File:DL44schematic-FF6.png|thumb|left|250px|DL-44 schematics]]
The DL-44 was a powerful, highly modifiable and accurate blaster pistol. It packed a heavy punch compared to other pistols without losing accuracy, which made it a prime choice among many groups and individuals, ranging from [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to military and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]].

Aside from being a powerful and reliable sidearm, the weapon had other attractive features such as a vibration system built into the handgrip that pulsed gently to alert the user that the weapon had only five shots left<ref name="EGWT" />, and the ability to charge a bolt twice as powerful into a capacitor without damaging the sidearm. Like most handguns, its gear typically included a motion-sensitive scope and [[Galven circuit/Legends|galven circuitry]] that allowed the pistol to deal more damage with a normal energy drain and fire rate.

==History==
[[File:RebelHeist1.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Han Solo wielded a DL-44.]]
Originally designed by BlasTech and seen as early as [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], the weapon found increased use at the hands of outlaws and fringers on the edge of legality, groups like smugglers and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] due to its capability to penetrate [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]]. This caused the Empire to put a restriction order upon this model, restricting and technically outlawing the purchase and ownership of the gun. This caused other companies to take advantage of the model and capabilities, releasing similar but tuned-down versions of the 44's, such as [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.'s]] [["Flash" 4]] and [[Model 57/Legends|model 57 blaster pistol]]. Their [[Power 5 heavy blaster pistol|Power 5]] was already being manufactured at the time, as it saw use during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Several variations like the [[DL-44 XT]] and it's lighter version [[DL44 Metal Pistol]], both featured metal in its construction. The [[Imperial Munitions/Legends|Imperial Munitions]] manufactured a [[Imperial Munitions Heavy Blaster Pistol|heavy blaster pistol]] that resembled to a DL-44 but had an increased damage output without losing the range.

[[File:Han_Solo_TCG_by_Dainche.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Han Solo wields his DL-44 on Hoth.]]
The DL-44 was the weapon of choice of the General and Alliance hero, once-smuggler [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who removed the barrel-sight to facilitate his fast-draw, something that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] deemed to be an illegal modification of a blaster. [[Gray Paladin|Grey Paladin]] [[Laranth Tarak]] also carried twin DL-44s as her primary weapons.

In a later era, [[Jaden Korr]], [[Rosh Penin]] and other [[New Jedi Order]] students carried DL-44 pistols when on missions where a blaster might be necessary. Some [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officers]], [[Imperial worker|workers]], and [[Imperial Saboteur|saboteurs]] affiliated with the [[Disciples of Ragnos]] were issued DL-44 handguns. [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] was also known to carry one of those on occasion. Prior to her defection to ''[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|The Rebel Alliance]]'', former [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] Captain, [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]], also carried a DL-44. Although, it rarely saw action after she was assigned as [[Galen Marek]]'s personal pilot. They were also the anti-infantry sidearm of choice for [[Rebel Marksman/Legends|Rebel Marksman]] and [[Rebel Vanguard/Legends|vanguards]], in addition to the vanguards anti-vehicle weaponry.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:DL-44_in_holster.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A DL-44 with holster.]]
[[Kenner Products|Kenner]] produced a full-size toy version of this pistol as part of its first [[Star Wars (Kenner toy line)|''Star Wars'' toy line]] in 1977. The toy was called simply a "laser pistol."

The DL-44 design comes from the German C96 "Broomhandle" Mauser pistol, an early semi-automatic handgun with a 10 round internal magazine and it was available in 9mm Parabellum or .30 Mauser.

The air conditioning vent on the front of the magazine came from a model airplane and the large flash hider came from the German MG81 machine gun from a fighter plane. The scope is the Hensoldt Wetzlar Ziel Dialyt 3x scope which was often seen on German sniper rifles such as the famous Mauser Kar98k bolt-action rifle. Due to the size of the flash hider, the iron sights were not useable.

Only 4 live C96 Mauser pistols have been remade to imitate the DL-44. YouTube firearm aficionado Jerry Miculek released a video using one of these real DL-44s on the 14th December 2015.

With the proper attachments, a real-life C96 could be used as a light carbine, like the DL-44 is shown to be rearranged as a long range rifle.
